exposure: Systemic isotretinoin exposure during and before pregnancy
cohort: The study enrolled 2,323 pregnant women who contacted the Clinical Pharmacology and Toxicology Unit for individual drug risk assessment between 2016 and 2020, with a focus on the 31 who had systemic isotretinoin exposure.
finding: There was no evidence of major birth defect, mental disorder, or retinoid embryopathy associated with systemic isotretinoin use in the prospectively followed, continued pregnancies.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed in 70.5% (12/17) of all deliveries in the systemic isotretinoin exposure group.
followup_time: Observations were taken after delivery, but no specific duration of follow-up (e.g., months/years after birth) is mentioned.
gest_age: The median gestational age at birth was 39 weeks, and no preterm births were reported.
